SH 对话增加收藏、复制 ID+路径、单条删除、超时批量归档与收藏筛选。
# dsh-archive-favorites-forge
> **功能描述**：DSH 对话管理工具箱：会话归档连文件一起归档，列表清爽但历史完整；收藏常看会话；按轮次撤销回复并保留轮次快照；一键清理快照与归档档案。适配 DSH 内核 0.2.2-rc.1。

>
> **English**: Conversation management for DSH: archive a session together with its files so the
list stays clean while history survives, star the ones worth keeping, undo the last reply with a per
-turn snapshot, and clean up snapshots and archived files from one panel. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc
rn snapshot, and clean up snapshots and archived files from one panel. Adapts DSH kernel 0.2.2-rc.1.

**Favourites, copy id+path, per-session delete, idle batch archive, a favourites
filter, and edit-re

send / undo-turn with automatic file rollback for DeepSeek
Harness conversations** — additive slot e

xtensions over the shipped archive
feature. It edits **no official file**.
**给 DSH 的对话加上收藏、复制 ID+路径、单条删除、批量归档闲置对话、收藏筛选，以及「编辑重发 / 撤销整轮 + 文件自动快照回滚」 —— 全部挂在官方插槽上，不改官方一行代码。**
English | 简体中文
## Why this exists

DSH already ships an archive feature: the Workspace registry keeps a global
`archivedSessionIds` set

and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` renders the
sidebar rows plus a view-options filter. Tha

t shipped feature has **no
favourites, no per-conversation delete, no copy-id/path affordance, and n

o
time-based batch archive** — and it deliberately refuses to open an archived
conversation. The tra

nscript has **no per-message edit or undo** either, and
nothing in the harness rolls back the files

an assistant turn rewrote. The
sidebar's "Ungrouped" bucket has **no explanation and no repair entry

ant turn rewrote. The
sidebar's "Ungrouped" bucket has **no explanation and no repair entry point**.

This plugin adds those things by attaching to documented official slot points,
so it composes with t
he shipped UI instead of patching it.
## Features · At a glance

> Every feature below marked "Settings → 归档助手" lives behind a
> **single row of function buttons** o

n one page: pick 快速上手 / 批量归档 /
> 删除归档 / 快照清理 / 缓存与未分组 / 收藏清单 and only that panel is shown. The
> oth

er panels are hidden, not unmounted, so a report you just measured is still
> there when you come ba

ck. The choice is remembered across restarts, and a new
> install lands on 快速上手.
| | 中文 | English |

; a menu row plus an inline ☆ star, applied optimistically |
| ② | **复制 ID + 路径**：「…」菜单一键复制会话 ID 与转录
文件绝对路径（两行） | **Copy id + path** — one menu row copying the session id and the transcript's absolute

path |
| ③ | **单条永久删除**：任意非收藏对话可删，二次确认；删完侧栏**立即移除该行** | **Per-conversation permanent delete** — any

non-favourite, behind a confirmation, and the sidebar row disappears at once |
| ④ | **批量归档闲置对话**：把闲
置超过 N 小时的未归档对话一次性归档，可撤回；**候选直接列在卡片里**（统一六列，见 ⑱），不必先导出清单才知道要归档什么 | **Idle batch archive** — archives
conversations quiet for more than N hours, undoable; the candidates are **listed right in the card**
in the shared six columns (see ⑱), so you never have to export a list just to see what would be arc

hived |
| ⑤ | **导出清单**：制表符分隔的 txt，含**对话名称 / 对话ID / 所属工作区 / 闲置时长 / 最后活动时间**；可复制路径或直接打开所在文件夹 | **Expor
t list** — a tab-separated txt with name, id, workspace, idle time and last-activity time; copy its

path or reveal it in the file manager |

### Where each feature lives
| Feature | UI location |

| Favourite / copy / delete one conversation | Sidebar row 「…」 menu (and a hover ☆ on the row) |
| I
dle batch archive, export list, favourites list, **batch delete of archived conversations (inlined l
ist, per-row ticks, dry run → confirm, its own pre-tick switch)**, **ungrouped health check**, **orp

han cache sweep**, **the six-column row format used by every list** | **Settings → 归档助手** |
| Favour

ites filter | **视图选项 → 筛选会话** |
| Edit-resend / undo turn / delete one message | The ↺ ✏️ 🗑 buttons

under each **user** message in the transcript |
| Undo and edit confirmation | A modal (`shell.overl

ay`) — the only place the plugin draws outside the sidebar |
| **Snapshot usage & cleanup** | **Sett
ings → 归档助手** (the 「快照清理」 card) |

**Slots used** (all documented in the harness client contract):
| Slot | What it contributes |
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` | 4 rows: favourite, copy id+path, continue in a new window

, delete |
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` | 1 hover ☆ star |
| `settings.section` | the 归

档助手 page |
| `shell.overlay` | the one confirmation modal used by edit-resend and undo |
**Host routes** (all under `/plugins/dsh-archive-favorites-forge`):
| Route | Purpose |

| `GET /status` | version + state paths, for diagnostics |
| `GET /favorites`, `POST /favorite` | th

e favourites set |
| `GET /archived`, `POST /unarchive` | the archived set, and undo of one archive

|
| `GET\|POST /idle-archive` | preview and apply the idle batch archive |
| `POST /export-list` | w

rite the tab-separated list |
| `POST /reveal` | open the file manager on a path |
| `POST /session-

info` | one session's title / workspace / transcript path |
| `POST /delete` | guarded permanent del

ete (batch; the session-menu delete goes through it) |
| `GET\|POST /archive-delete-policy` | the id

le pre-tick switch and threshold for the archive-delete list (**its own policy file**) |
